newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB shares down after negative comment.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB shares down after negative comment.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Plc fell in early trading on Monday after negative comment in the Financial Times' Lex column, traders said.
The stock was down 4-1/2p at 517-1/2 by 0816 GMT.

The FT's Lex column said BSkyB shares were trading on above-average multiple of 25 times expected 1999 earnings and could suffer regulatory worries with telecoms watchdog Oftel due to take over regulation of the satellite broadcaster next year.
It said a draft license specifying how the market is to be regulated is soon to be issued, marking a step-change for BSkyB which until now has been largely unregulated.
